The obsolete entry is Runtime Operations Preview using route runtime-v2-reference. Keep the production Runtime Operations entry.
Run this automated patch:
Bashpython - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "apps/lumina-builder/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx"
)

text = path.read_text()

old_item = '''          {
            icon: ServerCog,
            label: "Runtime Operations Preview",
            active: view === "runtime-v2-reference",
          },
'''

old_handler = '''                    } else if (
                      item.label === "Runtime Operations Preview"
                    ) {
                      setView("runtime-v2-reference");
'''

if old_item not in text:
    raise SystemExit("Runtime Operations Preview nav item not found")

if old_handler not in text:
    raise SystemExit("Runtime Operations Preview handler not found")

text = text.replace(old_item, "", 1)
text = text.replace(old_handler, "", 1)

path.write_text(text)
PY

grep -n \
  "Runtime Operations" \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx

npm run build

git status --short --branch
